## Why visit

A particularly satisfying pairing of an extraordinary room and an independent beer selection. The elaborate ceiling is the reason to stop and look up; the rotating cask and cider offering is the reason to stay. Different drinking areas let you appreciate the building without treating it as a museum. Its position at the Ancoats edge makes it an excellent anchor for a short northern-centre circuit, with Smithfield Market Tavern and Bar Fringe nearby. Choose this when both architectural spectacle and beer variety matter.

## Beer

CAMRA documents up to six changing cask ales drawn nationally; the operator emphasises craft ale, beer and cider.

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly lists one real cider. The operator also has a cider bottle selection; do not assume every product qualifies or remains in stock.

## Plan the visit

A particularly good room to see before the evening crowd. Verify food independently of pub opening hours; CAMRA reports an adults-only policy.

**Getting there:** Walk from Shudehill or Manchester Victoria; corner of Oldham Road and Great Ancoats Street.
